product_metadata.title: Air Purifier with Humidifier Combo, 2 in 1 Afloia HEPA H13 3-Stage Filters for Bedroom Pets Hair Smoker Odors, Evaporative Humidifier, Auto Shut Off, Quiet Air Cleaner with Seven Color Light, Black
features: 🍀【Separate Designed】: MIRO PRO is air purifier and humidifier in one machine. The main body is air purifier, the humidifier is installed on the air purifier and fixed bottom serration. The module of humidifier is independent and detachable, and the removal of the module does not affect the use of the air purifier alone. (Note: the humidifier module could not be used independently). Replacement purifier filter: Search for B08CVFXPMC on amazon.

🍀【3-in-1 HEPA Filtration】: The air purifier has a 3-stage filtration system(prefilter, activated carbon filter and HEPA filter). Improved Filter with larger expansion area and longer length than others. 360° air outlet, refreshes the air 5x per hour in rooms as large as 219 ft²/20 m² cover. No corner is left untouched and protects your health in all aspects

🍀【No Mist Humidification】: The evaporative humidifier works on evaporative principle to convert the invisible water into nano-water molecules to moisten the air. The evaporating humid air does not contain impurities, and the water-free mist will not accumulate dust, no water leakage and enjoy a healthy life. It’s real pure humidification without mist. Humidification replacement filter: Search for B08L98WGCH on amazon.
🍀【Seven Color Light】: Three light modes, seven color cycle-current color- light off. You can choose the preferred color. Silently cleans the room air during your sleep.

🍀【Filter Replacement Alert】Notice: Our machines are set up with a 2200-hour cartridge replacement reminder, the red indicator light will turn on when the purifier has been in use for more than 2000 hours. For the health of you and your family, we recommend that you replace the filter cartridge once every 3-6 months.
